insert into "mail_sender" (id, "user_id", "connection_id", "address", "name", "shared", "signature", "is_default", "created_at", "typed_at")
values (gen_random_uuid()::text, $1, $2, $3, $4, false, $5, false, $6, $7)
on conflict ("connection_id", "address_key") do update set "typed_at" = greatest(excluded."typed_at", "mail_sender"."removed_at" + interval '1 millisecond'), "name" = excluded."name", "signature" = excluded."signature"
returning id, "user_id" as "userId", "connection_id" as "connectionId", "address" as address, "name" as name, "shared" as shared, "signature" as signature, "is_default" as "isDefault", "created_at" as "createdAt", "typed_at" as "typedAt", "listed_at" as "listedAt", "provider_state" as "providerState", "provider_state_read_at" as "providerStateReadAt", "removed_at" as "removedAt"
